method: Three unvalidated parametric body sizes, separate limb capsules vs all external triangles; own-chair contact excluded explicitly. Hypotheses are not ANSUR percentile values or a validated humanoid rig. Negative contacts and foot gaps identify adaptation needs; clean proxies cannot approve comfort, vision, reach or sit/stand.
source_review: OSHA feet/support and adjustability principles; NASA task-specific fit/reach/view principles, no numerical anthropometric percentile claims.
